method: Keyboard input and accessibility-tree inspection in a desktop browser; saved HTML report viewed through its interface.
scope: Exploratory example and report review; not a repeated regression suite, pinned Chromium qualification, screen-reader review or human sign-off.

observed: Tab reaches opener; Enter focuses Display name.
Shift+Tab wraps to Close; Tab wraps back to Display name.
Escape closes and returns focus to opener.
Right arrow moves focus to Privacy while General remains selected.
Enter selects Privacy; Tab leaves the tab list for its panel.
Submitting the invalid sample reveals the error and focuses Email.
Entering reader@example.test and leaving the field removes the error and displays the cleared status.
Enter opens the portal with focus on Display name.
Shift+Tab/Tab wrap within the portal; Escape returns to opener.
Reopening after unmount restores initial focus and closes normally.
